text: 中指研究院发布的数据显示，9月中国100个城市新建住宅平均价格为每平方米17285元，环比上涨0.17%，同比上涨2.12%；<u>二手住宅平均价格为每平方米12452元，同比下跌6.94%，环比下跌0.6%，跌幅扩大</u>。 上海、北京等重点城市<u>优质新盘入市带动新房价格结构性上涨</u>；重点城市二手房成交量同比增长但价格下跌，其中，上海二手住宅价格环比由跌转涨，上涨0.11%。 中指研究院曹晶晶预计四季度楼市延续筑底，核心城市新房销售获支撑，<u>二手房价格短期或延续调整</u>。
text_en: Data released by the China Index Academy show that in September the average price of new homes in 100 Chinese cities was 17,285 yuan per square meter, up 0.17% month-on-month and up 2.12% year-on-year; <u>the average price of second-hand homes was 12,452 yuan per square meter, down 6.94% year-on-year and down 0.6% month-on-month, with the decline widening</u>. In key cities such as Shanghai and Beijing, <u>the launch of high-quality new projects drove a structural rise in new-home prices</u>; second-hand home transaction volumes in key cities rose year-on-year but prices fell, with Shanghai second-hand home prices turning from a decline to a rise month-on-month, up 0.11%. Cao Jingjing of the China Index Academy expects the property market to continue bottoming out in the fourth quarter, with new-home sales in core cities supported, while <u>second-hand home prices may continue to adjust in the short term</u>.
